title: Rupavahini — Nutan Musical Programme, 30 April 1982
license: none stated; posted by the programme's own director (Rupavahini production)
notes: the first music programme made in Rupavahini's small news studio, ten weeks after Sri Lanka's station signed on: two news cameras, a chroma-key backdrop, accordions, a singer at the microphone, hands on a keyboard, a flute under a Sinhala lower-third, and percussion
